snippet.title: MechWarrior 5: Clans - The Invasion Begins Now - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Greetings Warriors!

The Invasion Begins Now! 

Featuring more than 90 minutes of cinematic cutscenes, the linear-style MechWarrior 5: Clans follows the 2019 release of the sandbox-style MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries, and brings players a class of MechWarrior game not seen for decades in a narratively driven campaign playable solo or in up to five-player co-op.

MechWarrior 5 Clans is Available Now! 
https://mw5clans.com/purchase

- Experience challenging and immersive missions on multiple worlds.
- Pilot your Omnimech with streamlined Mech controls
- Command your Star with the intuitive Command Wheel, and dynamic Battlegrid.
- All new CLAN-themed metagame, Mechlab, and Pilot Progression.
- Playable with 1 to 5 Players with Cross-play Co-op on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series S|X, and PC 

Visit https://mw5clans.com/
